description: Buy a gift card for a person, paid online: the clinic's own (clinic_id) or GLØDI's on glodi.no. Give the amount, the buyer's name, mobile number and e-mail, and the recipient if it is a present. A code goes to the buyer; confirm_with_code then answers with the payment link, also sent by e-mail. Nothing is paid until the person pays on that link.

amount_nok.description: The gift card value in NOK.

clinic_id.description: The clinic_id find_clinics returns. Never build it from a name. A clinic site needs none.

email.description: The buyer's e-mail: the receipt and the payment link go there.

message.description: A greeting on the gift card.

name.description: The person's full name, as they say it.

payment_method.description: How the person pays on the payment link: card or Vipps.

phone.description: The person's mobile number. The code goes there by SMS.

recipient_email.description: Where the gift card is sent.

name: buy_gift_card

code_sent_to.description: The masked phone or email the code went to.

confirmation_id.description: Pass it to confirm_with_code with the code.

status.description: code_sent: ask the person for the code, then call confirm_with_code.

title: Buy a gift card
